title: The Builder Pattern
goal: Construct complex objects step by step without ambiguous parameters.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Builder Pattern

sections.text: You assemble complex objects with constructors in Java or named arguments in Python. Rust lacks method overloading and named arguments, so it uses the builder pattern instead.

sections.caption: The builder holds configuration before creating the final type.

sections.text: A builder struct starts with sensible defaults. Methods on the builder modify options one by one and return ownership of the updated builder.

sections.caption: Consuming and returning self enables method chaining.

sections.text: A final `build` method converts the builder into the target struct. This pattern validates arguments and keeps constructor calls clear.

explanation: Construct complex objects step by step without ambiguous parameters.
